title: Localized two-eigenvalue bound for finite noncomplete graphs
summary: For every finite noncomplete simple graph with at least two vertices, the sum of the squares of its two largest ordered adjacency eigenvalues is bounded by the sum over unordered edges of 2(1-1/c(e)), where c(e) is the largest clique containing the edge. The proof establishes the concrete edge-clique scalar certificate and transfers it through the checked BN completely positive spectral lift. Connectedness is unnecessary.

formalizes.title: The Bollobás–Nikiforov inequality for nonnegative edge weights

review.reason: Proves a localized bound on the two largest adjacency eigenvalues of noncomplete graphs.
